API ReferenceZscaler External Attack Surface Management APIFindingsRetrieves details for a finding based on the specified ID
Retrieves details for a finding based on the specified ID
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/easm/easm-ui/v1/organizations/:orgId/findings/:findingId/details

Retrieves details for a finding based on the specified ID. To learn more, see Understanding Finding Details.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
orgId
string
REQUIRED

Identifier extracted from the path. Renamed automatically; review the description and tighten the schema if needed.

findingId
string
REQUIRED

Identifier extracted from the path. Renamed automatically; review the description and tighten the schema if needed.

HEADER PARAMETERS
Authorization
string
REQUIRED

API authentication token

Default value: Bearer your-token
Responses
​
200
401
500

OK

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
category
string

The finding's classification such as Exposure, Vulnerability, or Misconfiguration.

cisa_likelihood
string

Indicates whether a vulnerability is listed in the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, if applicable.

country
string

The geographical location of the asset to which the finding is associated

description
string

A detailed description of the finding gathered from open-source intelligence, such as the National Vulnerability Database (NVD), and Zscaler's research team.

epss_likelihood
string

The Exploit Prediction Scoring System (EPSS) likelihood indicates the probability of a vulnerability being exploited in the wild, if applicable.

first_seen
string

The timestamp when the finding was first detected in the associated asset

id
string

Finding ID

impacted_asset_id
string

The ID of the asset to which the finding is associated

impacted_asset_name
string

The name of the asset to which the finding is associated

is_stale
boolean

A Boolean value that indicates if the asset was not detected in a scan for over 30 days and is therefore marked as stale

last_seen
string

The timestamp when the finding was last detected during scanning

name
string

Finding name

profile_id
string

ID of the Discovery Profile through which this finding was detected

risk_level
string

The risk level assigned to the finding ranging from Low, Medium, High, and Critical.

risk_score
string

A risk score computed for the finding ranging from 1 to 100

scan_type
string

The scanning service that was used to uncover the risk, such as Web, Network, Certificate, and DNS scans.

severity_score
number

The Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) score that indicates the qualitative measure of severity of a vulnerability using a numerical value ranging from 1 to 10, if applicable.

status
string

Indicates the finding's current status in its workflow tracked from discovery to closure

type
string

The finding's type which is a sub-classification within the assigned category
